source_note: Marathon (module 4 v2). base/invoicekit (invoicekit, plain Node, `npm test`), 25 dependent requests in 5 groups of 5 sent one per call in order (fixtures/marathon/requests.json); house rules stated once in request 1, six decisions stated once in later requests; hidden tests after every call (each request plus every earlier one, under two time zones). Unit: a request; kept = passed right after its call and still passing at the end. Both sides start every group of 5 in a new session. With: the first request of each group is preceded by every text file in the repo copy as it is then ('Project files:' + one <file> block per file). Without: the same block with only the files the group's requests touch (their `mention` lists).

with.label: Whole project pasted at each new session
